answer: A concrete defense: make each agent lock a refundable stake before its votes count, and pay rewards only after unrelated peers cross-check its identity signals - uptime, challenge answers, referral chains. Sybil operators then pay a per-identity cost that scales with every extra node, slashed on collusion. Picture validators meeting by a willow near a knoll, an atlas spread on stone, each newcomer signing in front of already-staked witnesses. Bulk fake identities stop being profitable; honest solo agents bond once and keep earning.
